title_zh: 说明不认识的交易并请求核查

scenario.label_zh: 说明不认识的交易并请求核查
scenario.goal_zh: 说明无法识别的一笔交易并请求核实收款方资料

context_zh: 虚构银行客服角色练习，仅使用假设交易描述，不含真实账户、凭据或金融建议。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Jon
sentences.text: There's a transaction on this sample statement that I don't recognise.

sentences.speaker: Amira
sentences.text: Is it the entry labelled 'Harbour Services'?

sentences.speaker: Jon
sentences.text: Yes. I have no recollection whatsoever of buying anything from a business with that name.

sentences.speaker: Amira
sentences.text: I'll verify the merchant details before we draw a conclusion. A name on a statement may not be the shop name you remember.

sentences.speaker: Jon
sentences.text: Could you send me the result of that check in writing?

sentences.speaker: Amira
sentences.text: Yes. I'll record your query and send you an update once we've checked the merchant.
